title: flixw lock.toml
description: The pin written by `./flixw pin`: the repository, exact version, distribution URL and SHA-256 of the Flix compiler a project runs. Generated and verified by flixw; committed, and not edited by hand.

wrapperVersion.description: the flixw release that last wrote this lock

repo.description: the owner/repository the compiler was fetched from

version.description: the exact compiler version: x.y.z, optionally with a prerelease and build metadata

url.description: the https URL the compiler JAR is downloaded from

sha256.description: the SHA-256 of that JAR: 64 lowercase hex digits

version.description: the Java that runs the compiler: a feature release (21) or an exact one (21.0.12)
